items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well Mike Neal, Beau and I... We played a gig.

ctx.x: Well Mike Neal, Beau and I, and I forgot who the drummer was, trombone, bass, two and drum. We played a gig. Without a trumpet. Oh yeah, without a trumpet. Yeah, without a trumpet. See, I tell you, now that's one thing I remember what my dad always said, you know, is learn the melody to a tune, see. Then the amplifiers after. Yeah. Well I like, I had a lot of advantage because I mean, I did learn a little bit about the piano, you know. I learned the changes. But I always tried to play a melody to a tune. Always…
Yeah that's one of the things most of the fellas in New Orleans tell us, that they try to always have that melody heard sometimes.
